Aim: To determine the internal resistance of a given primary cell using a potentiometer.
Procedure: Connect different electrical components as shown in the circuit (Fig. E 5.1). After checking the circuit connections, close key K1.

With keys K2 and K3 open and a protective high resistance P from the RBOX 2, find the position of the balance point. For final reading, short circuit the resistance P by closing the key K3 and find the balance length l0.
Take R = 10 Ω (from RBOX 1), close the key K2 and quickly measure the new balance length l. Open K2 as soon as this has been done.
Keep the readings in the ammeter constant throughout the above observation.
Reduce the value of R in equal steps of 1 Ω and for each value of R obtain the balance length l.
At the end of the experiment, open key K2 and repeat step 2 to find l0 again.

Components.Name: V1
Components.Title: (E)Voltage Source
Components.Description: Auxiliary battery for the potentiometer wire. Its emf should be greater than the emf of the primary cell.

Components.Name: RS1
Components.Title: (AJ = l) Meter Bridge
Components.Description: Potentiometer wire used to find the balancing length.

Components.Name: Am1
Components.Title: Galvanometer
Components.Description: A galvanometer is a sensitive instrument used to detect small currents in a circuit and locate the balance point.

Components.Name: K1
Components.Title: (K1)Plug Key
Components.Description: Main key for the potentiometer circuit.

Components.Name: K2
Components.Title: (K2)Plug Key
Components.Description: Key used to connect the external resistance load while finding l.

Components.Name: K3
Components.Title: (K3)Plug Key
Components.Description: Key used to short circuit protective resistance RBOX2 while taking final l0 reading.

Components.Name: V2
Components.Title: (E1)Voltage Source
Components.Description: Primary cell whose internal resistance is measured.

Components.Name: R1
Components.Title: Internal Resistance
Components.Description: Internal resistance of the primary cell, set near the expected result.

Components.Name: RS2
Components.Title: (R_Box1) Resistance Box
Components.Description: External resistance R used in the calculation r = ((l0 - l) / l) * R.

Components.Name: RS3
Components.Title: (R_Box2) Resistance Box
Components.Description: Protective high resistance box P, about 0–10 kΩ.
